payload.report_excerpt: Retrieval quality at long context lengths depends on where in the context the relevant passage sits, and although the size of the effect varies with model and prompt format, the reported pattern is consistent: accuracy is highest when the passage appears near the beginning or the end of the context window and lowest when it appears in the middle [Marek, 2023].
payload.source_excerpt: Across four models and three prompt formats, retrieval accuracy is highest for passages placed in the first or last decile of the context and drops by 12 to 21 points for passages placed near the midpoint.
